g.text: Pool and participation on shared numerical scales

g.text: Thin colored lines: each seed's 64-game mean; thick: equal seed means. Pale thin lines: individual held-out human groups.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b6c6df

g.text: Shading: central 10–90% of 192 generated games per family/rule; descriptive game variation, not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b6c6df

g.text: Recorded residual pool near 0.01 is preserved; generated worlds have no pool floor. Interpolating has no human Exp. 1 counterpart.
